rows.question: How do Shields work, and can they be healed?
rows.rawAnswer: A Unit’s Shield value is added directly to the HitPoints(HP) of its first model. For example, a Zealot (4 HP) with a Shield of 3 gives its first model a total of 7 HP. Lost HP from this combined pool can be healed normally.

rows.question: When exactly is SHIELDED Status lost?
rows.rawAnswer: SHIELDED Status is lost in either of the following two situations: • The Total Damage assigned to the Unit exceeds its Shield value. For example, a Unit with a Shield of 3 only loses its status after taking 4 or more damage, not 3. Because this is checked after damage is resolved, any abilities that reduce incoming damage before it is assigned can prevent the loss of SHIELDED Status. • The first model in the Unit is removed. Once SHIELDED Status is lost, it cannot be restored by healing.

rows.question: How is the Blast Template placed on a Psionic Storm token when resolving Psionic Storm?
rows.rawAnswer: Center-to-center. The Blast Template must be placed so that its center aligns directly with the center of the Psionic Storm token.
